camel_example: aliyun dbs RenewBackupPlan --region cn-hangzhou --UsedTime 1 --Period Month --BackupPlanId dbstooi01exxx
description_zh: 该接口用于续费一个DBS备份计划
kebab_example: aliyun dbs renew-backup-plan --backup-plan-id dbstooi01exxx --period Month --used-time 1 --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RenewBackupPlan

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup schedule
parameters.help_zh: 备份计划ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取此参数的值
parameters.name: backup_plan_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use yearly subscription or monthly subscription for the instance. Valid values:

Year

Month
parameters.help_zh:
指定预付费实例为包年或者包月类型，取值：
Year：包年
Month：包月
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the instance. Valid values:

If the Period parameter is set to Year, the value of the UsedTime parameter ranges from 1 to 9.

If the Period parameter is set to Month, the value of the UsedTime parameter ranges from 1 to 11
parameters.help_zh:
指定购买时长，取值：
当参数Period为Year时，UsedTime取值为1~5。
当参数Period为Month时，UsedTime取值为1~11
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求
parameters.name: client_token

BackupPlanId.description_en: The ID of the backup schedule
